title: Compactification lower shriek restricted to explicit-size localizing hulls
statement: Fix universes $u,w$, a commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$, a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ in universe $u$, and a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{i}\bar X\xrightarrow{p}Y)$. Let $F_c=Rp_*D(i_!)$ be the actual ordinary unbounded module-object derived functor of [def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek-compactification], and let $\mathcal H_X^{(w)},\mathcal H_Y^{(w)}$ be the full localizing hulls of [def-sfb-finite-tor-localizing-closure-of-size]. Given a proof that $F_c(K)\in\mathcal H_Y^{(w)}$ for each $K\in\mathcal H_X^{(w)}$, define $F_c^{(w)}:\mathcal H_X^{(w)}\to\mathcal H_Y^{(w)}$ by restriction: its object is $F_c(K)$ with this membership proof, and its morphism on an ambient arrow $a$ is $F_c(a)$. This is the full-subcategory lift of the ambient compactification composite; it chooses no adjoint and no new compactification.
